content: Properties of individual diagnostic services 21 of 45  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 681: AUTOSAR_RS_DiagnosticExtractTemplate Requirements on Diagnostic Extract Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: valid Description: The Diagnostic Extract shall support the definition of properties that are specific for a given diagnostic service. Rationale: Some properties of diagnostic services need to be individually fine-tuned for every instance of a given class of diagnostic service, e.g. ReadDataByIdentifier. Use Case: The user wants to define specific properties differently for all instances of a given diagnostic service. Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
